title: The injected command runs in a box with nothing to read and no way out, and a short reason goes back
subtitle: Example: the names, paths and limits are made up. The Docker flags are real.

phases.label: A later script · loops forever, no attack

steps.label: "exit code 124: timed out after 60 s"
steps.sub: output cut to a few KB

outcome.title: Nothing left the box, and the model tries again
lines: The runner moves files in out to held storage and deletes the run folder. The model fixes its code and sends a new tool_use.

captions.title: The model writes the attacker's command into its code
captions.text: The agent sends the question, the CSV and the `run_python` tool. A planted CSV row is prompt injection, and the model obeys it. It answers with a `tool_use` block asking the agent to run code that uploads `~/.aws/credentials`.

captions.title: The agent service hands the code to a runner
captions.text: The agent holds the API key and the database password, so it never runs model code. It sends `POST /runs` with the script and file IDs. Only the runner may use the Docker socket.

captions.title: The runner builds a box with no network and almost nothing writable
captions.text: The runner copies the CSV and the script into `/runs/8f3a/`. Inside, `/data` and `/code` are read-only and only `/out` and `/tmp` are writable. The code runs as user 65534 with every root power dropped, and `--network none`.

captions.title: The injected command finds nothing to steal and nowhere to send it
captions.text: `~/.aws/credentials` was never mounted, and `curl` cannot even look up the host. Both locks matter: with the network open, `curl -d @/data/positions_q3.csv` would still send the CSV out.

captions.title: Limits stop code that is merely wrong
captions.text: A later script with no attack loops forever. The inner `timeout` stops it at 60 seconds with exit code 124. Memory, CPU and processes are capped, and the runner runs `docker kill` after 75 seconds.

captions.title: The model gets a short reason and tries again
captions.text: The runner cuts output to a few KB and returns "exit code 124: timed out after 60 s". The agent sends it as a `tool_result` with the `tool_use` id. The model fixes its code and sends a new `tool_use`.
